The (h) ⎯⎯ of people in the world eating fish as their main source of protein is 40%. In case of our (i) ⎯⎯ to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, the pressure on fish will be increased and consequently people (j) ⎯⎯ on fish will suffer from hunger and poverty.
